name: Fairlife Ultra-Filtered 2% Reduced Fat Milk (Lactose-Free)
whyItWorks: Real dairy milk passed through patented soft filters that concentrate natural protein (13g/cup) and calcium while removing half the sugars, treated with lactase enzyme so it is 100% lactose-free. Easily absorbed nutrition.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drink cold from the fridge. Ideal for patients who crave the taste of real dairy without lactose bloating.
